defects.reproduction: Open / at 1600x1000 without a trusted handoff.
defects.issue: A marketing hero, rounded continuation card, footer prompt, and Pearl compete in one nominally idle surface.
defects.fix: Remove persistent hero and footer copy; reduce continuation recovery to one aligned hairline row.

defects.issue: The command form occupies a nearly full-height rounded sheet with no information density or hierarchy.
defects.fix: Use a content-sized left-rule emission, one 44px command row, and no decorative container.

defects.reproduction: Expand the injected Pearl on a normal page.
defects.issue: A floating rounded glass card, six persistent tabs, and weak 34px targets make the overlay feel detached and imprecise.
defects.fix: Convert the emission to a sharp edge-aligned instrument with 40px targets and hairline navigation.

defects.reproduction: Open a populated Scene and emit Scene controls.
defects.issue: The detached panel, capsule button, circular graph cards, and unrelated radii create four competing container languages.
defects.fix: Standardize emitted panels, material surfaces, graph nodes, and semantic controls on square 2px geometry and one separator system.

defects.reproduction: Compare web ledger, sidepanel actions, and injected overlay.
defects.issue: Spacing, target size, type scale, focus, line opacity, and radius are independently defined by each surface.
defects.fix: Import shared/pearl-interface-tokens.css in web and extension entry points and map all emitted UI to that system.

defects.reproduction: Use keyboard, touch, 360px width, 200% zoom, reduced motion, or increased contrast.
defects.issue: Several overlay targets are 22-34px and fixed-height sheets create avoidable clipping at zoom.
defects.fix: Keep controls at 40-44px, use content-sized emissions, preserve visible focus, and retain reduced-motion/high-contrast branches.
